android.desc: Sync for Lemmy is a full-featured app for browsing Lemmy on the go. Featuring secure login, comments, messaging, profiles and more. Sync for Lemmy highlights: • Material You design • A beautiful rich Material design user interface with loads of customizable options • A rich card experience with image, video and selftext previews • Amazing performance • Easily swipe back from messaging, comments, search and communities without using the back button • Multi account support • Best in class image viewer with support for images, GIFs, Gfycat, GIFV and galleries • Advanced submission editor with in-built editing options • Beautiful Night theme with AMOLED support • Color coded comments for quick scanning • Send messages to other users and received notifications of incoming messages • Browse random communities when you're bored! • Customize font sizes to suit your needs • And much more! What makes Sync unique? • Beautiful Material You design • Open multiple subs at once with multi window support! • Sort subs by most viewed • Long press any image to see a quick preview (and even albums!) • Super fast image loading • Per account setting profiles • Auto night mode Head on over to lemmy.world/c/syncforlemmy for news and discussion on the app! Please note, Sync for Lemmy is an unofficial app.
